text:
elaine: Quick heads-up — we're opening a constrained preview for a new inference-optimized SKU called Nimbus-XR in me-south (Doha) and ap-southeast-4 (Singapore-East). Goal: very low tail latency for regional chat endpoints and multimodal proxies. Reservation window opens 2026-09-07 03:00 UTC via Console + API. :globe_with_meridians:
omar: Nice. Nimbus-XR = new HW or tuned profile? any headline perf?
yuna: Tuned profile of our XR line with trimmed working sets and upgraded I/O paths for small-batch inference. Early bench: p50 ~22ms, p95 ~88ms on 4k context int8 with affinity. We'll publish the full bench next week.
elaine: SLA during preview: 99.9% reserved availability. Burst policy: short bursts allowed up to 10% of pool for 3-minute windows, 3x/day. Bursts are metered and may be throttled first 72h while we tune.
deploy-bot: Rollout plan: canary -> 15% -> 50% -> GA. Canary starts 2026-09-07 03:00 UTC. Extra tracing enabled for first 72h.
ops-bot: Initial fleet sizes: me-south = 24 units (6 clusters), ap-southeast-4 = 32 units (8 clusters). Per-org preview cap: 6 units.
omar: Migration path for customers on existing Nimbus reservations?
elaine: We'll offer a conversion path for active Nimbus customers: prorated credits + 45-day overlap. Submit interest here: https://intra.redwood.io/dedicated/migrate-nimbus (internal).
yuna: Tuning recs: enable per-request affinity, KV-prefix caching, and keep auto-batching <= 64 tokens for p95-sensitive services. For cost-sensitive workloads we recommend int8 qpack; int4 only after validation.
billing: Preview reservations use sku nimbus-xr.preview and are not billed until conversion or GA opt-in. Conversion offers include prorated credits for active Nimbus commitments within 45 days. For custom quotes please email billing@redwood.com.
partners: How do partners get demo slots?
elaine: Partners/CS can request demo quota via Console > Dedicated > Preview requests or ping me directly. We'll reserve demo slots for partner POCs.
sre: Note on network/backhaul for Doha — there's reduced cross-region burst capacity during preview to protect regional egress. Expect stricter burst throttles in first 72h.
omar: API snippet?
yuna: API example (internal):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/dedicated/reservations \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"region":"me-south","gpu_type":"nimbus-xr","units":2,"term_months":6}'
```
ops-bot: Quota increases: Console > Support > Dedicated quotas. Typical preview turnaround 24-72h.
elaine: I'll run a short walkthrough in #dedicated tomorrow 09:00 AST to demo reservation flow, migration options, and perf tuning. Ping me for a partner demo slot. :calendar:
